Christian Eriksen is conscious and doing well after another terrifying collapse on the pitch. 
During today’s international friendly between Denmark and Ukraine, the football world held its breath once again. 

In the 65th minute, Eriksen clutched his chest and collapsed.  

The specialized Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator (ICD) he was fitted with following his cardiac arrest at Euro 2020 worked flawlessly. 

The Danish team doctor confirmed that the life-saving pacemaker responded exactly as intended.  
The match, which was a tune-up friendly as neither nation qualified for the upcoming 2026 World Cup, was immediately abandoned.

Eriksen is currently at the hospital undergoing further examinations, but the Danish Football Federation has confirmed he is stable and recovering.   
Some things are just so much bigger than the game.  
Sending our thoughts and best wishes to Christian Eriksen and his family!
